findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: There were still mouse droppings observed under shelving in the dry storage. The PIC was alerted and will have the custodian clean the droppings up. There are sticky traps in place and the facility is aware of the rodent issue. Discussed continuing to clean these mouse droppings to allow for proper monitoring of the rodent issue and ensuring that food is being protected in this area. Ensure that pest control is regularly treating for the issue and that any holes in the walls that are allowing access for the rodents are being sealed. A spot check will be conducted on 11/16/2026 to ensure that the mouse droppings are being cleaned and the issue is being monitored.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.111 (A)(B) and (D) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (A) Routinely inspecting incoming shipments of FOOD and supplies; (B) Routinely inspecting the PREMISES for evidence of pests; and (D) Eliminating harborage conditions. [C]

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Observed 2 gallons of milk to be stored past its 7 day date marking maximum. Discussed with PIC, education was provided on proper date marking and milk was discarded. Ensure any TCS item is discarded after its 7 day date marking maximum.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
A small metal spoon was found resting on stove shelf in front a cooking pot of beans. CORRECTED - spoon was taken to dish area and a new spoon will be used for stirring beans.  Spoon will be stored in food, with handle extended out of pot.  All utensils should be stored a) in food with handle extending up, b) clean and dry or c) in running water dipper well.
750-280 Food dispensing utensils shall be stored in the food with the handle extending out of the food; or stored clean and dry; or stored in running potable water dipper wells.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.comment:
Mouse droppings were noted in corner of kitchen next to soda bottle storage (north end of pass-thru window), throughout metal cabinet that runs under pass-thru window, and in dry storage.  All food, utensils, and single service items are well-protected.  Outer opening is tight-fitting and self-closing.  Kitchen manager states there has been no pest activity noticed, and pest control has not reported any mice caught in traps.  Remove droppings, sanitize locations where droppings are found, and work with pest control operator to eliminate pests.  Continue good food and utensil protection practices.  Will follow-up in two weeks.
750-1160 Effective measures to minimize the presence of rodents and insects shall be utilized. Provide effective pest control.
